categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily focuses on the research, development, production, sales, and service of digital X-ray flat panel detectors. Its product applications span medical imaging (including general radiography, mammography, dynamic fluoroscopy, radiotherapy, dental 3D imaging, and veterinary medicine), industrial non-destructive testing, security inspection, and pet medical fields. The company also develops intelligent DR solutions and imaging technology solutions, expanding its product portfolio beyond flat panel detectors to integrated imaging systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include amorphous silicon TFT/PD design and manufacturing, cesium iodide scintillator evaporation and packaging, dynamic series high-level application technology, AED and DAEC technologies (wired and wireless), intelligent collimators, and intelligent DR solutions. The company emphasizes in-house production of key components like cesium iodide scintillators and TFT/PD to ensure quality and protect core technologies. It also employs advanced manufacturing processes such as thin-film transistor arrays, scintillator crystal growth, and integrated image processing software development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are digital X-ray imaging system manufacturers serving hospitals, veterinary clinics, industrial enterprises, and security inspection departments. The company’s products are sold domestically and internationally, targeting medical institutions for clinical diagnostics, industrial clients for non-destructive testing, and security agencies for inspection equipment. Major end markets include healthcare (human and veterinary), industrial manufacturing, security, and emerging markets such as aerospace and new energy sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Suzhou Industrial Park. It has established subsidiaries and sales/service centers in the United States, India, Japan, South Korea, Italy, Singapore, and other regions. Its sales and service network covers domestic markets and extends to North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, South America, and the Middle East, with ongoing efforts to expand presence in emerging markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of core digital X-ray flat panel detectors and related components. It controls key upstream processes such as scintillator evaporation and TFT/PD manufacturing, while outsourcing lower value-added assembly and surface mount technology. Downstream, it supplies finished detectors and integrated imaging solutions to system manufacturers and end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening R&D in digital X-ray flat panel detectors, expanding into intelligent imaging solutions, and advancing key component technologies like collimators, X-ray tubes, and high-voltage generators. The company invests in CMOS and IGZO sensor technologies, photon counting detectors, and flexible substrate detectors. It pursues innovation through internal development, acquisitions (e.g., ISDI Limited), and collaborations, aiming to become a provider of integrated intelligent imaging technology solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of digital X-ray flat panel detectors, key components, and integrated intelligent DR solutions. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, serving both domestic and international customers. It also recognizes revenue from customized product development and after-sales services. Financial income from investments and government subsidies contributes marginally to total revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer of digital X-ray flat panel detectors, ranked ninth globally and second in China by market share in 2018. It competes with international giants such as Varex, Trixell, Canon, and Fujifilm. The industry is highly concentrated with top three players holding over 50% market share globally. The company leverages its technological innovation and cost advantages to increase its market penetration and drive import substitution in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 298 million, an 8.9% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 17.65 million, up 14.54%. R&D investment accounted for 14.67% of revenue. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with improving profitability and cash flow. Total assets reached about RMB 967 million, with a slight increase from the previous year, reflecting ongoing investments in production capacity and technology.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-performance digital X-ray flat panel detectors with superior image quality, low radiation dose, and advanced features such as wireless dynamic imaging and intelligent collimation. It differentiates through proprietary technologies like cesium iodide direct growth scintillators, DAEC dose control, and integrated intelligent DR solutions. Its comprehensive product portfolio covers diverse applications, enabling tailored solutions and strong customer loyalty. Cost-effective manufacturing and global service networks further enhance its competitive edge.
